findings.issue: No error handling for non-404 API failures: createAsync throws, there is no ErrorBoundary or onError anywhere, and main renders empty
findings.suggestion: Add an ErrorBoundary (or createAsync onError) at the app or route level rendering a simple 'Something went wrong' page inside main

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are never removed; eviction only happens on rejection, so stale entries accumulate for the process lifetime
findings.suggestion: Delete entries whose expires has passed on lookup (or occasionally sweep), so the 60s TTL actually bounds memory

findings.issue: `groups.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)` produces NaN comparisons if any version group's order is null
findings.suggestion: Use `(a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0)` or a comparator that handles null orders explicitly

findings.issue: All six pages' view models plus shared indexes live in one 340-line module; the app's future choke point
findings.suggestion: Split into per-resource modules (home, pokemon, move, ability, type) sharing pokeapi.ts and the index helpers

findings.issue: API payloads are typed `any` throughout (api<T = any>, casts on stats/types/abilities) despite strict mode and a hand-typed view-model layer
findings.suggestion: Define minimal payload interfaces for the endpoints actually consumed so strict: true pays off at the API boundary

findings.issue: The `Show when={x()} fallback={<Show when={x() === null}>}` loading-vs-notfound idiom is duplicated across four route files and relies on the undefined/null distinction surviving query serialization
findings.suggestion: Extract a small `<ResourceView data={x()} notFound={<NotFound/>}>{(v) => ...}</ResourceView>` component

findings.issue: Header columns come from the declarative COLUMNS array but tbody cells are hand-written in a fixed order, so the two can silently drift
findings.suggestion: Render tbody cells from the same columns() list used for the header, or leave a comment linking the two orders

findings.issue: Search-param normalization (`param`) and `gameParam` are implemented separately in two files
findings.suggestion: Move a single `firstParam` helper into lib/format (or lib/params) and reuse it

summary: This is a well-executed SolidStart v2 app: config, scripts, data loading, routing and SSR mode all match the current docs, and the server/client boundary is exactly where the framework wants it. The spec's hard parts (species-vs-pokémon mapping, filter state in the URL, sort edge cases) are handled deliberately and readably in a small, cohesive set of modules. I'd merge after one light round — adding error handling for non-404 upstream failures and evicting expired cache entries are the only changes I'd insist on.
